## Vendors

The vendors this dataset is loadable for, as declared in [Loader settings](Parameters-loader-settings.md) — this table is a tabulation of that input. Each pairs a coexistence tag with the programme it runs, and the loader substitutes the two together, making one copy of the vendor-scoped data per row. Each vendor has its own care team with one practitioner on it, carrying resolved values and no tag of their own.

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| [xb](vendor-xb.md) | kpro | Kommunal PRO |
